The '''Resistance on Cyrillia''' was an engagement that took place around [[12,700 BBY]] at the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Cyrillia">{{CSWECite|I|157|Cyrillia}}</ref> [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]]. It was a late confrontation of the [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]], a war that had commenced more than [[13,050 BBY|three centuries]] earlier and was one of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies.<ref name="EGTW" />

Cyrillia was situated in the [[Exploitation Region|region]] actively controlled by the [[Grand Companies]]&mdash;[[Merchant/Legends|trading]] conglomerates based along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as [[the Spin]] and backed by Coruscant&mdash;and lay along a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route mostly controlled by the Republic's capital. Following the Resistance on Cyrillia, the Fifth Alsakan Conflict itself also ended around 12,700 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Resistance on Cyrillia was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
